policies.title: Slovenian ordinary passports: Chad electronic visitor visa
policies.summary: Slovenia's current guidance says Slovenians need a visa for Chad, whose current official notices require new visa applications electronically before travel.
conditions: Apply through Chad's official eVisa platform before travel; standard processing is 10 working days and express processing is 72 hours.
The Slovenian passport must be valid at least six months on entry; approval, documentary, health, security, carrier and final-admission checks remain applicable.
This applies only to the ordinary Slovenian visitor passport that Slovenia's current guidance says requires a visa.

application.label: Chad official e-Visa platform
application.processingTime: 10 working days standard or 72 hours express.
steps: Submit the ordinary Slovenian-passport visitor application online before travel.
Travel only after issuance and retain the required supporting documents.
